evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L23: For the fiscal 2027 first quarter, revenues of $14.1 million increased $0.4 million, or 3%, as compared to the prior year period. This primarily reflected higher revenues from league distributions of $1.2 million, mainly due to an increase in certain league distributions unrelated to national media rights fees, partially offset by other revenue decreases.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L24: Direct operating expenses of $8.8 million increased $5.2 million as compared to the prior year period. This was primarily driven by (i) higher net provisions for certain team personnel transactions of $3.1 million and (ii) higher team personnel compensation of $1.3 million.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L25: Selling, general and administrative expenses of $28.1 million increased $5.8 million, or 26%, as compared to the prior year period. This increase was primarily driven by (i) expenses related to the spin-off transaction in the current year period of $3.6 million and (ii) higher employee compensation and related benefits of $1.4 million.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L26: Operating loss of $23.6 million increased $10.7 million and adjusted operating loss of $21.3 million increased $10.9 million, both as compared to the prior year period, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses and direct operating expenses.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L28: MSG Rangers Corp. (MSG Rangers) is a leading professional sports company, with a collection of assets that includes the New York Rangers (NHL) and a development league team, the Hartford Wolf Pack (AHL). MSG Rangers also operates a professional sports team performance center, the MSG Training Center in Greenburgh, NY. More information is available at msgrangers.com.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L31: We define adjusted operating income (loss), which is a non-GAAP financial measure, as operating income (loss) excluding (i) depreciation, amortization and impairments of property and equipment, goodwill and other intangible assets, (ii) share-based compensation expense or benefit, (iii) restructuring charges or credits, (iv) gains or losses on sales or dispositions of businesses, and (v) the impact of purchase accounting adjustments related to business acquisitions. Because it is based upon operating income (loss), adjusted operating income (loss) also excludes interest expense (including cash interest expense) and other non-operating income and expense items. We believe that the exclusion of share-based compensation expense or benefit allows investors to better track the performance of our business without regard to the settlement of an obligation that is not expected to be made in cash.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L32: We believe adjusted operating income (loss) is an appropriate measure for evaluating the operating performance of our Company. Adjusted operating income (loss) and similar measures with similar titles are common performance measures used by investors and analysts to analyze our performance. Internally, we use revenues and adjusted operating income (loss) as the most important indicators of our business performance, and evaluate management’s effectiveness with specific reference to these indicators. Adjusted operating income (loss) should be viewed as a supplement to and not a substitute for operating income (loss), net income (loss), cash flows from operating activities, and other measures of performance and/or liquidity presented in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”). Since adjusted operating income (loss) is not a measure of performance calculated in accordance with GAAP, this measure may not be comparable to similar measures with similar titles used by other companies. For a reconciliation of operating income (loss) to adjusted operating income (loss), please see page 5 of this earnings release.

evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L73: • Share-based compensation. This adjustment eliminates the compensation expense related to restricted stock units and stock options in all periods.
evidence.text.ed17aac93a11.L74: • Restructuring charges. This adjustment eliminates costs related to termination benefits provided to certain employees.
